load_model_gpt_oss: load the gpt-oss-120b model with tensor parallelism and bfloat16 dtype
apply_chat_template_prompts: apply chat template to a batch of user messages and generate formatted prompts
generate_responses_batch: generate responses for a batch of prompts using continuous batching
decode_model_outputs: decode model generation outputs and extract assistant responses
configure_generation_params: configure generation parameters like max_new_tokens for model inference
